newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: GOLF-BALLESTEROS JUNIOR SHOWS DAD HOW TO WIN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BALLESTEROS JUNIOR SHOWS DAD HOW TO WIN.

text.p: Baldomero Ballesteros, son of Severiano, has just won his first tournament -- aged six.
"It was a competition for five-to-10-year-olds and he had 35 points over nine holes," said Europe's Ryder Cup captain, who caddied for his son at the Pedrena course in Spain.
"That was a great achievement and he's started winning well before I did!"
Like Tiger Woods, who became the youngest winner of the U.S. Masters this year at the age of 21, golf seems to have come naturally to young Baldomero.
"He's been playing for two years and I've never had to teach him a thing.

"He just watches. But that is great because I want him to discover all the things about golf himself," added Ballesteros, who has been struggling to achieve a tournament success of his own for two years.
